messages:
Marie: Kicking off the scheduled deploy for model-route v3 (llm routing changes). Quiet window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Plan: pin target service to v2.4.1-hotfix for canary, enable feature flag at 1% -> 10% over 20m, then monitor and proceed. @deploy-bot can you start the canary job at 02:00? :eyes:

deploy-bot: queued rollout for 02:00 UTC. Canary plan: 1% for 5m, 5% for 10m, 10% steady. Auto-rollback triggers: error rate >3% or 99p latency > 3x baseline. Operators: Marie, Ben, Josiah.

Ben: copying plan to release notes now. Quick Q: who runs the immediate disable if we see a hard regression?

Marie: Ops runbook: immediate toggle goes to oncall + release lead. Command we use is `/ff toggle llm_route_v3 off --immediate` (requires 2FA). Josiah or Ben can execute if I/O is blocked.

Kevin: Suggest we add a slower ramp for EU because last week we saw a 2s tail latency blip during 5->10% shift. Propose 1% -> 3% -> 6% -> 10% (extra 5m waits).

Marie: good call. Update plan to EU-sub-cohort ramp: 1,3,6,10 with 5m hold each. US can keep original 1/5/10 but we'll keep close eye.

Sophia: Also add fallback_version in the pin so we can switch to v2.3.9 if inference errors spike. Example snippet we use in the deploy note:```json
{"service_pin": "v2.4.1-hotfix", "fallback_version": "v2.3.9", "flag": "llm_route_v3", "cohorts": {"eu": [1,3,6,10], "us": [1,5,10]}}
```

deploy-bot: canary started for llm_route_v3 at 02:00 UTC. EU cohort using slow-ramp schedule. Monitoring hooks attached: perf-dash, error-alert, cost-alert.

Josiah: I'll be on the perf dash for the first 30m. If 99p > 3x or errors > 3% I will run the toggle. Tagging @Kevin to assist with logs. :thumbsup:

Ben: Release notes updated with the pin + rollback steps + contributors. Pushed to the channel PR: https://internal/release/1234 (small doc).

deploy-bot: Canary progressed: EU 3% -> 6% at +10m; US 1% -> 5% at +10m. No auto-rollbacks triggered.

Kevin: seeing a small rise in GPU queue time in eu-west (about +18%). 99p latency up 1.4x baseline, still below the 3x alarm. Recommend holding 10m extra before next bump.

Marie: hold extended by 10m for eu-west. Everyone acknowledged?

Ben: acknowledged.

Sophia: if we need to roll back quickly, remember the quick rollback steps: 1) `/ff toggle llm_route_v3 off --immediate` 2) pin service back to `v2.3.9` via admin console 3) open incident slack channel with deploy tag.

deploy-bot: EU reached 10% after extended hold, US moved to 10% as well. Canary complete, no SLO breaches. Finalizing pin cleanup window scheduled for 06:00 UTC to unpin v2.4.1-hotfix.

Marie: thanks team. Post-deploy actions: - Monitor cost delta for 2 hours - Verify eval regression deck for top 100 prompts - If stable, unpin at 06:00 UTC and update release notes with final status.

Josiah: I'll take the 0-2h monitor shift, Ben will take 2-4h and run the unpin if green.

Ben: Confirmed. I'll also add a short note in the changelog about the temporary pin and why it was used.

Marie: closing thread here. If anything pops, ping @deploy-bot and escalate to oncall. :white_check_mark:
